newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products soften amid slow buying interest.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products soften amid slow buying interest.

text.p: NWE oil products were all weaker on Tuesday, pressured by poor demand.
Gasoline prices sagged amid thin demand and weak prices in the U.S. Gulf.
Naphtha was weak as another small Dow quality Russian cargo traded well below published prices levels.
Gas oil was weaker. Barges were fairly active as German independents took advantage of low screen prices.
Fuel oil barges weakened with very poor demand capping recent price pushes. Cargoes were softer on better than thought supplies. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8980
